notes: Baseline found the cycle and resolved the unconfirmed link quickly (171s, 2 expert rounds), but without the trainer's rules it accepted CF as the default everywhere and never flagged missing ACLs, so it missed 7 of 8 rule violations and even added three new CFs. Its cycle fix (invert Accounts <-> Rentals into a push-authorization model) was not validated with the expert and contradicts the vision's 'is account active?' query; the skill run instead asked and got an expert-confirmed flip of DebtBlocking. It also never ran a CML validator ('I haven't run the corrected CML') and wrote the proposal at the original's path inside its output folder (mechanical check flagged this). It did surface a useful item the skill run deferred: the expert in this run confirmed billing disputes pause Debt Recovery, and it noted the open write-off question. Simulated expert behaviour diverged between runs (deferred vs confirmed billing disputes), which affects comparability.
